result.limitation: Validate assumptions and current AWS documentation. This is not an official AWS review, security audit, deployment or price quote.

findings.message: Secret value inline in the configuration file; use a reference or the client's secret store.
npx package without a pinned version (some-files-server); every start may run different code.
Non-interactive install flag; pair it with a pinned version and a reviewed package.

rules: Pin every package version and review the changelog before upgrading
Secrets live in the client secret store or environment, never in the file
Auto-approve only read-only tools of servers you trust and have reviewed
Prefer remote servers with HTTPS and published privacy notes over local installs you have not read
limitations: Field names vary by client (autoApprove is Kiro-style; VS Code uses servers); unknown fields are ignored
Cannot verify the package contents or the remote server behavior
